name: westwood_online_upgrade_download_event_sink_release
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDownloadEventSink::Release decrements and returns the event sink refcount, destroying and freeing the sink at zero.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The wider download event-sink vtable is still under reconstruction; this target verifies the callback body directly.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x442790 validates a one-argument stdcall COM Release wrapper that calls imported InterlockedDecrement on self->m_refCountAndLock.refCount, skips teardown when the new count is nonzero, and at zero calls WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDownloadEventSink::Destructor followed by operator delete before returning the new count.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_download_event_sink_release_smoke verifies the nonfinal decrement path and a final heap-backed release path that exercises the recovered destructor and frees storage, including live-count decrement evidence.
